How we work

A clear purpose. An agreed role. A practical way forward.

You can begin with a specific question, an opportunity or a business challenge. Together, we define the work, the contribution SetuHashi will make and how we will assess progress.

Our role

Our involvement fits the assignment.

SetuHashi can advise, develop business, coordinate organizations or help create something new. Where separately agreed, we may also participate in a venture.

  • Adviser

    Help you assess options and make informed decisions.

  • Business developer

    Approach customers or partners and develop opportunities on your behalf.

  • Integrator / orchestrator

    Bring capabilities together and coordinate the organizations involved.

  • Co-creator

    Help partners shape and test a new offer or business opportunity.

  • Venture participant

    Contribute agreed resources or capital and share a venture’s risks and rewards.

Roles can combine. They are not stages, and there is no assumed progression towards a larger engagement or venture participation.

Our role, authority and commitments are agreed for each assignment.
